lines: To the point where I forget the scars.
About the meaning of being born.
I end up thinking about it, with regret.
First, move your hands to keep living.
Someday, will I even love these dirty hands?
Until I notice that, I will keep singing.
I wonder what I can see.
First, move your hands to be loved.
Someday, I want to link these dirty hands with you.
Until I notice that, I will keep singing.
The heart begins to know that.
Until I notice that, I will keep singing.
Even if I come to understand nothing at all.
